facts.claim: The Central School at Mercara was established in 1862 after a petition by Coorg headmen.
facts.quote: the first decisive step having been taken in 1862, when the Coorg Headmen petitioned Government for assistance

facts.claim: The Central School at Mercara has grown to serve as a preparatory institution for the third form.
facts.quote: the Central School at Mercara gradually advanced to its present position, the first decisive step having been taken in 1862

facts.claim: The Coorg headmen petitioned the government to improve welfare and requested the Chief Commissioner to consider their wishes.
facts.quote: We, the undersigned Headmen of Coorg, being the representatives of our countrymen, beg most respectfully to lay before you what is now upper- most in our minds and what appears to us of the greatest importance for the welfare of our people
